tasks.description: The dashboard will be used to display reports. The details of the reports are still to be determined. This task involves setting up the basic structure of the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is logged in, when they navigate to the reports section, then the dashboard is displayed.

tasks.description: This task involves determining the specifics of the reports that will be displayed on the dashboard. This includes the type of data, the format of the reports, and any filtering or sorting options.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of report requirements, when the requirements are reviewed, then the report details are documented.

tasks.description: This task involves implementing the display of the reports on the dashboard. This includes integrating the report data with the dashboard and ensuring that the reports are displayed correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report is selected, when the report data is loaded, then the report is displayed correctly on the dashboard.
